name: job-application-autofill
description: Chrome extension to autofill job applications

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && npm run copy-files
scripts.copy-files: cp manifest.json dist/ && cp content.css dist/ && cp background.js dist/ && mkdir -p dist/icons && cp -r icons/* dist/icons/ 2>/dev/null || true
